basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.new: FROM presented UNION ALL SELECT md5(transaction_line_id||'_'||transaction_id||'_'||reporting_accounting_period_id||'_Cumulative Translation Adjustment_0'),transaction_id,transaction_line_id,subsidiary_id,subsidiary_full_name,subsidiary_name,subsidiary_currency_symbol,reporting_accounting_period_id,ending_at,period_name,is_adjustment,is_closed,'Equity','Cumulative Translation Adjustment','Cumulative Translation Adjustment','Cumulative Translation Adjustment','cumulative_translation_adjustment',NULL,(SELECT account_number FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts WHERE lower(type_name)='cumultransadj' LIMIT 1),FALSE,FALSE,CASE WHEN lower(general_rate_type) IN ('historical','average') THEN converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period ELSE converted_amount_using_reporting_month END,unconverted_amount,16 FROM presented

edits.old: coalesce(CASE WHEN is_balancesheet THEN account_id END,'')
edits.new: coalesce(CASE WHEN is_balancesheet THEN account_id END,'0')

CASE WHEN NOT is_balancesheet THEN lower(replace(out_type,' ', '_')) WHEN lower(type_name)='retearnings' THEN 'retained_earnings' WHEN lower(type_name) IN ('cta-e','cumultransadj') THEN 'cumulative_translation_adjustment' ELSE type_name END

edits.old: CASE WHEN NOT is_balancesheet OR is_leftside IS FALSE THEN -coalesce(converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period, converted_amount_using_reporting_month) ELSE coalesce(converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period, converted_amount_using_reporting_month) END AS converted_amount
edits.new: CASE WHEN NOT is_balancesheet OR is_leftside IS FALSE THEN -CASE WHEN lower(general_rate_type) IN ('historical','average') THEN converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period ELSE converted_amount_using_reporting_month END WHEN is_leftside THEN CASE WHEN lower(general_rate_type) IN ('historical','average') THEN converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period ELSE converted_amount_using_reporting_month END ELSE 0 END AS converted_amount
